lead: Two procedure stations: sterile speculum examination in pregnancy (swabs, ruptured membranes) and digital vaginal examination in labour (cervix, station, position, Bishop score).
f: Suspected ruptured membranes · bleeding with a known non-praevia placenta · discharge, swabs · no digital VE in suspected PPROM or unknown placental site

sc: Suspected ruptured membranes → Sterile speculum only, no digital VE

f: Cusco: bivalve, self-retaining, views the cervix · Sims: single blade, needs an assistant, views the anterior wall (VVF, prolapse)

Warm it, wet with sterile water (no gel when testing for ROM) · part the labia · insert closed, sideways, pointing back · rotate 90°, open, lock · look at the cervix and fornices · loosen before removing
High vaginal swab from the posterior fornix · endocervical swab inside the os (1–2 cm) for chlamydia and gonorrhoea · ROM: pool of liquor, flow on coughing, nitrazine turns blue, fern on a slide

Every 4 h in the 1st stage (2 h on oxytocin) · not before the placenta is located in APH · two fingers along the back wall · dilatation, effacement, consistency, position, application · membranes and liquor (clear, meconium, blood)

sc: APH, placental site unknown → No VE: scan first
tr: No cervix felt around the head = fully dilated

f: Dilatation, length, station, consistency, position · ≥ 8 favourable · ≤ 6: ripen the cervix first · maximum 13

Station 0 = level of the ischial spines · posterior fontanelle: Y-shaped, 3 sutures · anterior: diamond, 4 sutures; easily felt = deflexed · moulding +3 (not reducible) = obstruction · caput is soft swelling
